title: Six Women Sitting on Lake Dock, 1960 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot showing a group of six women posed together on a wooden dock at Pell's Lake, taken around 1959–1960. Three women sit on the dock bench in front while three stand behind them, dressed in mid-century summer clothing including short-sleeved blouses, shorts, and eyeglasses. The photo features a deckle-edge border stamped 'JULY 1960' on the right margin and handwritten 'Pell's Lake - 1959' on the bottom margin.
